name: Sakurano Maeko
source:
The younger of the two thieving foxgirls. Friendlier and more energetic than her older sister, but due to being spoiled and taken care of too much by said sister, she is quite naïve and clueless about a lot of things. Headaches seem to be a common thing for her. Most likely the easiest girl to warm up to for the MC.
